-   [Contact](#)

# Why is there no sound?

[](javascript:window.print() "Print this article")

If you're not hearing any sounds from Vector, please:

 

1.  [**Reboot Vector**](https://support.anki.com/hc/en-us/articles/360009804394-How-to-reset-erase-and-restore-Vector)
2.  Adjust the volume on Vector. To do this: open the Vector app &gt; tap Settings. If the volume is already on med or high, adjust it anyway to reset the volume
